ImageDescription.value: Arms of the municipality of Ullensvang, located in the county of Vestland, Norway. The design is inspired by a tombstone at Ullensvang Church, belonging to the lawman Sigurd Bynjulvsson, who died in 1302 or 1303. As a municipal symbol, the arms were originally approved for the "old" municipality of Ullensvang by royal resolution 1979-10-08. At this point in time, the tinctures were red and gold. As the "old" municipality of Ullensvang was to be merged with Jondal and Odda into a new, larger municipality of Ullensvang (effective 2020-01-01), it was decided that Ullensvang's "old" arms should be kept by the new municipality, while changing the tinctures from red and gold to blue and silver.
